# Competitive Price Move Brief

The listed Edge X1 price changed from USD 1,200 to USD 1,080\. The prepared price move warrants review, but its market effect is not established\. Review the listed price change and gather attributable relationship evidence before considering a competitive response\. Ownership, motive, and market effect are not established\.
